_note: Skills with receipts — no levels or ratings; the evidence links do the grading. `competencies` are the groups; `crossings` are tools shared between two adjacent groups. Evidence `href`s are pinned (verified 2026-10-20): internal routes to the Story/Data pages, plus real mlops repo files and a real CI run.
title: Skills
intro: The tools I reached for on this project, each tied to the exact place it earns its keep. Follow any link to the evidence.

competencies.name: Keeping data honest
competencies.line: Nothing reaches a model before it has a version and a check.

tools.name: DVC
tools.did: Versions the dataset out of Git and into the one S3 bucket.

tools.name: Pandera
tools.did: Checks the data's shape before it can reach training.

competencies.name: Training models
competencies.line: A model has to beat the last one before it can ship.

tools.name: PyTorch
tools.did: Trains the small network that guesses your drawing on the home page.

tools.name: scikit-learn
tools.did: Gives the baseline the trained model has to beat.

tools.name: the pipeline
tools.did: Every step, from the data checks to the quality gate.

competencies.name: Shipping it
competencies.line: From a trained file to a live address, and back down to zero.

tools.name: Docker
tools.did: Packs the model and its server into one image.

tools.name: Terraform · AWS Lambda
tools.did: Serves the model, and scales to zero between visitors.

tools.name: EKS
tools.did: Builds the monthly Kubernetes cluster and tears it down again.

competencies.name: Watching it run
competencies.line: Proof that the model still works after it ships.

tools.name: MLflow
tools.did: Records every run; the registry promotes the winner.

tools.name: Evidently
tools.did: Compares this week's predictions against the training data.

tools.name: Grafana
tools.did: Keeps the load-test dashboards as evidence.

competencies.name: Building the front
competencies.line: The page you are reading, and the demo on it.

tools.name: Next.js · TypeScript
tools.did: This site: a static export that calls the live model.

tools.name: the data contracts
tools.did: Type the JSON contracts that the Data pages read.

crossings.name: S3
crossings.line: One bucket holds the data, the models, and the evidence.

crossings.name: ONNX
crossings.line: The model leaves PyTorch as ONNX, so a cold start stays short.

crossings.name: k6
crossings.line: Puts load on the live model each month and records the result.

crossings.name: GitHub Actions
crossings.line: Retrains on each model change, and deploys this site.

toolbox.label: Also in the toolbox
toolbox.note: Used across the project, without a headline of their own.
